_note: Models the external baseline calls, all routed through Cloudflare AI Gateway. 'kind': 'clairic' = native state+fields schema (non-chat); 'chat' = OpenAI-compatible messages. Clairic is the only non-chat model here. 'params' is merged into the request body verbatim. Reasoning cannot be disabled through this gateway: gpt-6.1-sol rejects 'none' and 'minimal' as unsupported values (accepts 'low'), claude-opus-5.5 takes the Anthropic effort knob instead: output_config.effort='low', gemini-4-argon accepts 'minimal' but it does not change its output size. Max output tokens must be run at 12000: at 4000 the 64,883-token CUAD document makes gpt emit nothing (reasoning consumed the budget), and truncates gemini/opus mid-JSON; 16000 is rejected with HTTP 500.
